summary: STMicroelectronics filed a 6-K announcing the pricing of a US$1.5 billion dual-tranche convertible bond offering (two tranches of US$750 million each, maturing in 2031 and 2033). The zero-coupon 2031 bonds and 0.625% 2033 bonds are offered at par with conversion premiums of 55% and 57.5%, respectively. Proceeds will redeem existing 2027 zero-coupon convertibles and for general corporate purposes. The filing reflects a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation; the conversion feature is customary. BNP Paribas and J.P. Morgan acted as joint global coordinators. The expected settlement is June 23, 2026.
